messages:
claire: Need a compact benchmark narrative for launch assets. Goal: show latency vs unit economics without making it read like a price sheet. Thoughts on one hero visual + one technical deep-dive.

noah: For hero, i prefer an indexed 'throughput per $' bar (Redwood = 1.0) with % delta labels. Keeps headline claims qualitative and lets the appendix show numbers.

toni: Design options: A) tokens-per-$ horizontal bars, p95 mini-sparkline trailing each bar. B) 2x2 grid: median vs p95 on y, tokens-per-$ on x, tiny badges for model family. A is cleaner for landing; B for technical blog.

lee: also add a small heatmap inset showing tail risk (probability of >500ms at peak load). enterprise folks care about that more than raw median.

sam: inbound routing: three-tier CTAs: 1) Developers -> "Try in 5 mins" (self-serve), 2) Platform teams -> "Request architecture review" (form + AE), 3) Procurement/Legal -> "Get compliance brief" (email). Keep ad copy non-numeric: "More predictable inference economics."

noah: methodology note: we'll publicize index + % deltas and include a downloadable CSV + raw traces (sanitized). Footnote: "Synthetic steady-state service workload; batching + KV cache on; see methodology."

claire: copy tests: short headline variants: "Predictable token economics at production scale" / "Lower dollar-per-token, tighter tail latency" / "Cut inference surprises, not just costs" which should be primary?

toni: i like the first for landing. second for webinar creative. third for an email subject line (intriguing).

lee: webinar 30s teaser: 1) the problem: unpredictable per-token costs and tail latency, 2) what we built: routing + batching + model profiles, 3) outcome: lower $/token and stable p95 under load. include a 1-slide demo of the heatmap.

sam: tracking: download PNG/CSV should tag lead with "bench-download" source and route enterprise downloads to AE queue. Also add a separate webinar signup param to route registrants.

asset-bot: Asset task created: https://app.shortcut.com/redwood-inference/story/bench-3087654321 assets: chart-png, chart-csv, heatmap-svg (assignees: noah, toni, sam)

claire: action items: noah -> indexed CSV + heatmap numbers (Weds EOD), toni -> hero mock + tooltip microcopy (Thurs AM), sam -> CTA copy + routing rules (Thurs), lee -> webinar slide + 30s script. reconvene Fri sync to pick final hero. thanks :sparkles:
